note: Washington County Park Authority park on South Holston Lake (lake is TVA, park is county-run). About 140 full-hookup (30/50-amp) RV sites, campers up to 42 ft, plus tent sites, 7 shelters, swimming beach, 2 boat launches; showers, laundromat, Wi-Fi. Open April 1 to October 31. Book online through the Park Authority's Firefly reservation page or the front booth; seasonal sites go by waiting list. The campground fills a narrow lake peninsula - outer-loop full-hookup RV sites back directly onto the lake (some with docks); inner sites have lake views. --Claude
